edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Shocking Orb banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: Justice Punch (E) is down 11s at rank 1, 7s maxed — Galio has no engage while it's on cooldown, so push then. Keep your E Shocking Orb banked for the dash. His R (180s CD at rank 1) shields on cast — force it out before you all-in.

edits.before: Good trade: Q the pair from beyond answer range, W the dodge, walk — one-way ledgers per wave. Bad trade: Charging Q inside hook range — the artillery that forgets geography becomes the exhibit.
edits.after: Good trade: Q Galio's duo from beyond his 825-range Q, then walk — free damage he can't answer. Bad trade: standing in after Colossal Smash's (P) auto-reset windup — that tell means disengage, not just dodge Q.
